title: ARCADE LOOT IS HOLD E AGAIN
why: His order of 2026-10-11 evening: he does not like the walk-over loot in the arcade and wants hold E to loot back. In the arcade a box is searched again only while E (or X, or the pad search button) is held, at the usual speed, like every other raid. The controls card on the demo video and at each spawn gains a LOOT row, so a walk-up player knows to hold it. Valuables still turn into points.
now: Arcade looting is hold E again, like every other raid, and the controls card shows it.

edits.replacement: var ARCADE_SRCH=1, ARCADE_LOOT_DIV=10;   // v23.xx: his order, hold E to loot at the usual speed (was 6, walk-over loot)

edits.anchor: ['EXTRACT','HOLD '+kn('KeyE')+' IN A TEAL RING','HOLD '+padB('X')+' IN A TEAL RING']];
edits.replacement: ['EXTRACT','HOLD '+kn('KeyE')+' IN A TEAL RING','HOLD '+padB('X')+' IN A TEAL RING'],['LOOT','HOLD '+kn('KeyE'),'HOLD '+padB('X')]];   // v23.xx: hold E to loot, so the card says so
